correctness.rationale: The proof first classifies all perfect divisor counts compatible with \(\Omega(n)<8\), leaving only exponent patterns \((5)\) and \((2,1)\), then eliminates both for odd sublime numbers by the one-odd-prime structure of even perfect numbers. For \(\Omega(n)=8\), the unique divisor-count pattern is \((6,1,1)\), and comparison with the Euclid--Euler factorization gives a biconditional Mersenne/cyclotomic characterization.
